dates.note: reports Abhinavagupta's oneness with Mahesvara (comm. on Paramarthasara)

name: Yogaraja
summary: Witness and scholiast: testifies Abhinavagupta had attained oneness with Mahesvara, and his Samgrahavivrti commentary carries the Paramarthasara line.
